quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’ve been working on a side project called *Capshot* – a mobile app that automatically generates short, catchy captions for your photos and videos using AI.

The idea came from noticing how much time people spend thinking of a "perfect one-liner" before posting on Instagram, X, or TikTok. Most apps help with editing visuals, but captions are usually left up to the user.

*Key features:*  
- AI-powered caption suggestions tailored to the content  
- Multiple styles (casual, witty, professional, etc.)  
- One-tap sharing to social platforms  
- Currently available on Android, iOS version coming soon

I’d love to get feedback from the community on:  
- Potential use cases beyond social media (marketing, content creation, accessibility, etc.)  
- How to better evaluate caption quality  
- Concerns around dataset bias or ethical use of AI-generated text

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.capshot.app  
Website: https://capshot.ai

Thanks for reading, and I’m happy to answer any questions!
